poetryFrame.leftVertical: YOUR HEART IS A WHISPER IN THE BLUE HOUR LIGHT
poetryFrame.rightVertical: WE WILL LIVE WITHIN THIS DREAM OF FOREVERMORE
poetryFrame.bottomLine: A LOVE THAT TRANSCENDS TIME AND TIDES
sonnetLines: The tide pulls out to meet the stars,
A quiet promise whispered on the breeze.
We trace the map of where forever are,
Among the salt and ocean mysteries.
Your gaze holds all the light I need,
A steady beacon through the shifting haze.
Beyond the passing of these fleeting days.
Let memory become our guiding art,
A tapestry woven from deep midnight blue.
To hold your soul within my beating heart,
My endless devotion waits for only you.
We are bound by waves and lunar sheen,
The deepest color ever truly seen.

lyrics.text: Your morning eyes, I could stare like watching stars
I could walk you by, and I'll tell without a thought
You'd be mine, would you mind if I took your hand tonight?
Know you're all that I want this life
I'll imagine we fell in love
I'll nap under moonlight skies with you
I think I'll picture us, you with the waves
The ocean's colours on your face
I'll leave my heart with your air
So, let me fly with you
Will you be forever with me?
My love will always stay by you
I'll keep it safe, so don't you worry a thing
I'll tell you I love you more
It's stuck with you forever, so promise you won't let it go
I'll trust the universe will always bring me to you
I'll imagine we fell in love
I'll nap under moonlight skies with you
I think I'll picture us, you with the waves
The ocean's colours on your face
I'll leave my heart with your air
So, let me fly with you
Will you be forever with me?
